description: One short link (animalmath.com/s/<code>) to a set of Animal Math resources: printables (or some of their pages), makers set up, quizzes at a level, tools and whole curriculum lessons, split into days if wanted. The set page shows them all and makes one PDF of the printables. Checked here: items not found come back with a suggestion, and the short link is made once every item is found. Give the teacher the short link.

days.description: In place of items: each day's items, for a plan of several days (Day 1, Day 2, ...).

items.description: Set items, as the other tools give them: printables/<slug>, printables/<slug>/pages=2;5, generators/<slug>/<id>=<value>/..., quizzes/<slug>/level=<id>, tools/<slug>, curriculum/<grade>/<lesson> (curriculum/3rd-grade/4.2).

note.description: A line under the title, for the teacher.

name: make_set_link
title: Make a set link
